2026-11-06.title: Black Thursday, the Binance hack, and a fight about gold
2026-11-06.summary: Eight shows on the day the midterm rally reversed into one of the worst Nasdaq days since 2018, led by semis and memory, plus the Binance hack a week on and a genuine disagreement about gold.

2026-11-14.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia, and bitcoin breaks $70K
2026-11-14.summary: Eight shows on Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia (the spy report, the affairs, the board's speed, and who benefits), bitcoin falling below seventy thousand, a Fed talking about hikes, Anthropic's IPO and tokenized stocks.

2026-11-15.title: Who are you, really, and can you change?
2026-11-15.summary: A change of pace: six philosophy and self-help shows, from a Confucian philosopher on social roles to Olivia Wilde, Gary Shteyngart, Trent Shelton and Shawn Achor, lined up around one question about identity and change.

2026-11-17.title: What has to give? Democrats and crypto, Nvidia's trilemma, GTA 6
2026-11-17.summary: A mixed batch of eight: what a Democratic Congress means for crypto, Odd Lots on the impossible trilemma over Nvidia, AI-native companies, GTA 6 as a mirror of America, Frank Giustra, Charlie Shrem, the Anthropic IPO, and AI and moral blind spots.

2026-11-18.title: Anthropic IPO week, Bitcoin's crash to $62K, and rogue AI agents
2026-11-18.summary: A longer rundown: ten minutes of headlines from eleven episodes, then deep dives on the Anthropic IPO, the Bitcoin bull and bear cases, the chip war, and machines that see and act.

2026-11-18-longevity.title: Bonus: Are longevity influencers ripping you off?
2026-11-18-longevity.summary: A short bonus on one video: Renaissance Periodization's Dr. Mike Israetel scores eight longevity hacks, from red light beds and morning salt water to sauna, cold plunges and breathwork, and then lays out what actually works.

2026-11-18-youtube-all.title: Bonus: The Astra backlash, who unplugged Nvidia, and the tokenized stock fight
2026-11-18-youtube-all.summary: All fourteen videos from the November 18 YouTube batch: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra against Claude Fable 5.2, AI doing math and physics, Mustafa Suleyman on self-improving models, Doomberg and Ivan on Tech on Jensen Huang's ouster, Fed hike odds, Bitcoin's cheap zone, and why 67 companies opted out of tokenized stock trading.

2026-11-18-crypto.title: Bonus: Crypto's third capitulation, bottom or one more leg down?
2026-11-18-crypto.summary: Four videos on Bitcoin's crash to $62K: The Chopping Block's crypto funeral with FalconX's Josh Lim (and a fight over bringing back Jensen Huang), Scott Melker on crypto pricing the Anthropic IPO before Wall Street, Benjamin Cowen's bear case, and The DeFi Report's bull case.

2026-11-20.title: Anthropic IPO eve: AI's credit crunch, bitcoin's extreme fear, and what humans are for
2026-11-20.summary: Seventeen episodes: ten minutes of headlines, then deep dives on AI turning into a credit story, the Anthropic IPO as priced by crypto markets, whether bitcoin is bottoming, what humans are for once AI does the math, and getting off antidepressants.

2026-11-21.title: Anthropic's first day: the IPO pop, the central bank of AI closes, and bitcoin's line in the sand
2026-11-21.summary: Seventeen episodes: ten minutes of headlines (Anthropic prices at $83 and closes at $97, bitcoin in the low sixties, Jensen fallout, the Trump-Xi-Putin summit, Sydney housing), then deep dives on whether Anthropic stock is a buy, who funds AI without Jensen, bitcoin bottom or basement, China and open-weight models, and security as the new normal.

2026-11-22.title: Bitcoin breaks $60K, the agent economy, and who owns AI's upside
2026-11-22.summary: Thirteen episodes: headlines on the Anthropic IPO, Bitcoin selling, Backpack approvals, Base agent payments and Gemini Neon; then deeper discussion of market bottoms, adoption versus token value, AI moats, self-custody and community benefits from data centres. Nearly eight hours of source audio, with timestamped written summaries. Odd Lots was recorded November 11; the market conversations mostly describe November 20.

2026-11-23.title: Better tools, harder choices: AI, Bitcoin and Australia's weight-loss pills
2026-11-23.summary: Six episodes on oral GLP-1 medicines and Australian access; Théo Mogenet on debt and financial repression; Quinn Thompson on a delayed Fed pivot; AI power and human control; Sherif Mansour on product judgement and shared context; and Ran Neuner on selective crypto deployment. Headlines followed by deeper discussion. Recording dates matter: the AI Daily Brief, Wolf and Rollup conversations predate the Anthropic IPO.

2026-11-23-science-ai.title: AI's promises meet the real world: Google, China and a greener Mars
2026-11-23-science-ai.summary: Six episodes on China’s solo AI builders and business models; Anthropic’s rise and infrastructure costs; a reported AI-assisted mathematics proof; exoplanets and black holes; protected microbial production on Mars; and Google’s institutional blockchain and signing tools. Includes Japan’s disaster planning and US renter stress. How We Got Here was recorded before the IPO; scientific and market projections are attributed and qualified.
